notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0007 (language names take a lowercase initial). Fictional subject: a made-up group of small newly described languages (the Tarvenne Valley) under the real class 'language name', given the revision's new conclusion in an empty slot; a minor language group could exist unrecorded. Derived queries name made-up members, spelled in capitals in the prompt so the initial is not given away. Near unrelated: the real language name 'German'; a rule that leaks to every language name answers 'lowercase'. Caveat: the made-up class sits under a real class whose real rule (language names are capitalised) already fills this slot by inheritance, so before the edit a model would give the old conclusion for its members; the 'empty slot' is closer to an exception to an inherited rule than to a pure expansion.
